(2) Replace Proposition 1’s constant-Y pair by this positive-dimensional binary family on the same observed-A closure graph. Let P(Z=1)=lambda in (0,1), P(A=1|Z=z)=alpha_z in (0,1), set X=A, and on the observationally reached rows set P(Y=1|A=0,X=0)=r_0 and P(Y=1|A=1,X=1)=r_1 with r_0,r_1 in (0,1) and r_0 != r_1.
